+import json
+import os
+import sys
+import threading
+

+def parse_args():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("--url", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--language", default="en-US")
+    parser.add_argument("--punctuate", action="store_true")
+    parser.add_argument("--api-key", default=os.environ.get("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY"))
+    return parser.parse_args()
+

+    create_resp = requests.post(

+        headers=headers,
+        json={"audio_url": media_url, "language_code": language, "punctuate": punctuate},
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    create_resp.raise_for_status()
+    transcript_id = create_resp.json()["id"]
+    stop_event = threading.Event()
+
+    def poll():
+        while not stop_event.is_set():
+            resp = requests.get(
+                f"https://api.assemblyai.com/v2/transcript/{transcript_id}",
+                headers=headers,
+                timeout=30,

+            resp.raise_for_status()

+                print(data.get("text", ""))
+                stop_event.set()
+            elif data["status"] == "error":
+                raise RuntimeError(data.get("error", "transcription failed"))
+            else:
+                print(data.get("text", ""), flush=True)
+            stop_event.wait(2)
+
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=poll, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    thread.join()
+
+
+def main():
+    args = parse_args()
+    if not args.api_key:
+        raise SystemExit("ASSEMBLYAI_API_KEY is required")
+    stream_transcript(args.api_key, args.url, args.language, args.punctuate)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import json
+import os
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Any, Callable, Dict, List, Optional
+
+from google.cloud import speech_v1p1beta1 as speech
+
+
+@dataclass
+class RecognitionResult:
+    text: str
+    is_final: bool
+    confidence: Optional[float] = None
+
+
+def _build_client() -> speech.SpeechClient:
+    return speech.SpeechClient()
+
+
+def _streaming_config() -> speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig:
+    return speech.StreamingRecognitionConfig(
+        config=speech.RecognitionConfig(
+            encoding=speech.RecognitionConfig.AudioEncoding.LINEAR16,
+            sample_rate_hertz=int(os.getenv("GOOGLE_SPEECH_SAMPLE_RATE", "16000")),
+            language_code=os.getenv("GOOGLE_SPEECH_LANGUAGE", "en-US"),
+            enable_automatic_punctuation=True,
+        ),
+        interim_results=True,
+        single_utterance=False,
+    )
+
+
+def handle_streaming_recognition(audio_chunks: List[bytes], on_result: Callable[[RecognitionResult], None]) -> List[RecognitionResult]:
+    client = _build_client()
+    config = _streaming_config()
+
+    def requests() -> Any:
+        yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(streaming_config=config)
+        for chunk in audio_chunks:
+            yield speech.StreamingRecognizeRequest(audio_content=chunk)
+
+    results: List[RecognitionResult] = []
+    for response in client.streaming_recognize(requests())
+        :
+        for result in response.results:
+            if not result.alternatives:
+                continue
+            transcript = result.alternatives[0].transcript.strip()
+            if not transcript:
+                continue
+            partial = RecognitionResult(
+                text=transcript,
+                is_final=result.is_final,
+                confidence=getattr(result.alternatives[0], "confidence", None),
+            )
+            results.append(partial)
+            on_result(partial)
+
+    return results
+
+
+def parse_recognition_event(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> RecognitionResult:
+    text = payload.get("transcript") or payload.get("text") or ""
+    is_final = bool(payload.get("is_final", payload.get("final", False)))
+    confidence = payload.get("confidence")
+    return RecognitionResult(text=text, is_final=is_final, confidence=confidence)
+
+
+def merge_results(results: List[RecognitionResult]) -> str:
+    committed: List[str] = []
+    partial: str = ""
+    for item in results:
+        if item.is_final:
+            if item.text:
+                committed.append(item.text)
+            partial = ""
+        else:
+            partial = item.text
+    if partial:
+        committed.append(partial)
+    return " ".join(committed).strip()
*** End Patch

+import asyncio
+import os
+from typing import AsyncIterator, Optional
+
+import httpx
+
+
+OPENAI_AUDIO_STREAM_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/speech"
+
+
+async def _iter_source_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], max_chunk_size: int) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    buffer = bytearray()
+    async for part in source:
+        if not part:
+            continue
+        buffer.extend(part)
+        while len(buffer) >= max_chunk_size:
+            yield bytes(buffer[:max_chunk_size])
+            del buffer[:max_chunk_size]
+    if buffer:
+        yield bytes(buffer)
+
+
+async def stream_audio_chunks(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], chunk_size: int = 4096) -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=None) as client:
+        headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('OPENAI_API_KEY', '')}"}
+        async with client.stream("POST", OPENAI_AUDIO_STREAM_URL, headers=headers) as response:
+            response.raise_for_status()
+            async for upstream_chunk in _iter_source_chunks(source, chunk_size):
+                if upstream_chunk:
+                    yield upstream_chunk
+            async for chunk in response.aiter_bytes():
+                if chunk:
+                    yield chunk
+
+
+async def stream_from_async_source(source: AsyncIterator[bytes], chunk_size: int = 4096) -> list[bytes]:
+    chunks = []
+    async for chunk in stream_audio_chunks(source, chunk_size=chunk_size):
+        chunks.append(chunk)
+    return chunks
+
+
+async def _empty_source() -> AsyncIterator[bytes]:
+    if False:
+        yield b""
+
+
